findings.title: Mandatory transaction-owner regression is still failing
findings.description: The exact required transaction_owner_regressions_pass command reports 1 failed, 57 passed at tested_commit c414cd12384a29e607e552c62e5e9199cdf401f9. test_reauthorize_requires_atomic_intent_success moves the RUNNING INTENT to 2026-09-27, where its fixture already has RUNNING INTENT_2 for the same subject and PLAN purpose. The additive uq_s27_active_partition correctly rejects that fixture update before the intended head-day mismatch denial oracle runs. The packet requires every exact check to pass, so DoD and merge-gate conditions remain unsatisfied despite the other twelve successful checks. The committed BLOCKED/FAIL/UNMERGED result accurately represents this state.
findings.required_change: Obtain narrow governance rescoping for the fixture-only correction, or merge a separate authorized correction, while preserving the frozen active-partition index and the existing mismatch oracle. tests/db/test_transaction_interfaces.py is explicitly excluded from KL-024's current write scope; do not edit it under this packet or waive/skip the regression. Rerun all exact checks against the resulting implementation revision, persist new SHA-bound evidence/result, and obtain fresh required reviews after any substantive change.

review_notes: Fresh independent GENERAL inspection used the current indexed authorities, full KL-024 packet, repository pr-merge-reviewer skill, merged KL-015 result/integration, M2 closure, relevant frozen Protocol sections 2, 6.1-6.5, 6.7, 6.9 and T4/T5/T6, relevant DB table/owner/lock/invariant clauses, full base-to-head implementation/test/contract diff, committed result and raw evidence. Implementation-thread reasoning was not used as approval authority.

The tested-to-reviewed suffix is one linear commit adding only the task result and new task evidence. KL-015 merge 7623c20bb267a39b8d02c29845b4ee054714d2b1, M2 evaluated revision 08f3a985e52150a18678d2f913c0a8d6a44792b1, and reviewed merged KL-023 implementation/result 6cd15b03cb0206156b8e295d34516f457c7b046a are ancestors. The prior serialized core task is present in the base.

Validated the committed result against THREAD_RESULT.schema.json and checked all thirteen command evidence files for the exact tested SHA and consistent exit codes. Twelve required commands exit zero; the owner regression exits one. Planning PU reports 2 passed, planning DB reports 6 passed, migration regression reports 26 passed, and the owner regression reports 1 failed, 57 passed. No result, requirement, review, release or merge PASS is inferred from successful local checks.

Database suites were not rerun by GENERAL; the DB_CONCURRENCY reviewer owns that lane. Their committed logs and service-level test assertions were inspected.

Reviewed versioned structured normalization, NFC/whitespace rules, equipment set semantics, ordered collections, collision/type/size/depth denial, and separation of the subject/date/purpose partition from semantic fingerprint and calendar scope. Admission resolves the active S05 policy under S01, enforces policy purposes/triggers/calendar/quota/concurrency and new-root capacity, and records root limits/reserved/settled categories without fabricating plan success or authorization.

Reviewed the bounded T4 planning basis and deep-copy protection: JOIN returns current identities without S28/S29, quota debit or S27 mutation; REVISE appends one immutable request and CREATED attempt, marks only the exact prior attempt STALE, and switches pointers while retaining root counters, lease/fence and original deadline. Tests assert persisted identities/counters/pointers, return-to-old-constraints new revisions, replay conflicts, basis changes, rollback and old-request/attempt denial through existing command guards.

Reviewed typed AcquireLease/RenewLease CAS identity checks, trusted time after coordination, monotonic fencing, bounded expiry, post-lock renewal reread and terminal/current-chain denial. Their generic mutation and aggregate-lock capabilities remain S27-only; downstream attempt advancement owns attempt progression. The shared current-fence guard rejects frozen terminal attempts while retaining documented merged nonterminal compatibility. PostgreSQL test code uses bounded barriers/events and observed pg_blocking_pids/Lock state for acquisition/takeover and renewal waiters.

Reviewed atomic owner use, subject namespace binding, actor/command/client-key receipt and event identities, historical replay without current worker authority, and the under-S01 replay recheck. Positive planning S27/S28/S29/S30 mutations in DC tests call the service; direct admin writes are identified as prerequisite or negative time/state/index controls. Failure injections assert planning/quota/receipt/event/outbox rollback. Service command transactions contain no provider/model/network waits.

Scope comparison confirms only declared implementation paths and task-scoped result/evidence were changed. The one new migration follows d4c1a9e7b203 and implements frozen active subject/date/purpose uniqueness with explicit legacy PENDING compatibility. Historical migration files, excluded transaction fixture, frozen Protocol/DB/FROZEN_BASELINE, current document index and requirement registry are byte-identical to base. No shared package marker, downstream model/dispatch/reaper implementation or product requirement status was changed.

GENERAL identifies one BLOCKER and no additional REQUIRED_FOLLOWUP or NONBLOCKING finding. The failed fixture is a scope/governance repair, not evidence that the frozen uniqueness constraint should be weakened. No merge recommendation is issued. Separate PROTOCOL and DB_CONCURRENCY reviews are still required and cannot override the mandatory FAIL. This review makes no production activation, real-data shadow execution, W04-W06 release or product requirement PASS claim.
